## [1.3.0](https://github.com/Supperelias2/sbs-morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0) (2026-11-21)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* expose experimental mobile patches in regular source updates ([6196127](https://github.com/Supperelias2/sbs-morphe-patches/commit/61961279d9d1578acfc61d943aaa26ca5faa24f6))

### ✨ New Features

* add mobile Morphe settings and experimental playback controls ([0735c5f](https://github.com/Supperelias2/sbs-morphe-patches/commit/0735c5f1d3ecbba9c20529384218ad2baf6eb8fb))

patches.name: Experimental: automatic intro and recap skipping
patches.description: Experimental separate opt-in VOD intro and recap skipping, once per segment and media item.

patches.name: Experimental: binge-watching preset
patches.description: Adds an opt-in preset button for automatic intros/recaps, uninterrupted watching and a shorter next-episode delay. Individual switches remain available.

patches.name: Experimental: bounded VOD buffer recovery
patches.description: Experimental opt-in restart after 25 seconds of continuous direct-VOD buffering, with at most two attempts per media session. Live, ads, DRM and player errors are excluded.

patches.name: Experimental: clean paused picture
patches.description: Adds opt-in hiding of controls while paused, using the synchronized SBS visibility path. Off by default.

patches.name: Experimental: controls timeout
patches.description: Adds an opt-in controls timeout to Morphe settings. Normal three-second behavior is preserved by default.

patches.name: Experimental: correct intro and recap seeking
patches.description: Experimental provider-aware VOD skip correction. Enabled in Morphe settings by default.

patches.name: Experimental: custom seek intervals
patches.description: Experimental separate rewind and forward intervals for player and live controls, with matching PiP descriptions. Defaults to 15 seconds.

patches.name: Experimental: customize subtitles
patches.description: Adds optional subtitle size, bottom margin, and high-contrast styling to Morphe settings. Disabled at runtime by default; SBS mobile 6.4.0 only.

patches.name: Experimental: external direct-stream player
patches.description: Adds opt-in handoff of direct VOD to an installed video player. DRM content stays in SBS; session/format limitations can apply.

patches.name: Experimental: local playback diagnostics
patches.description: Adds an opt-in provider, resolution, bitrate and buffer overlay. Does not show stream URLs or account data.

patches.name: Experimental: next episode countdown
patches.description: Adds an opt-in next-episode delay preference. Original autoplay, cancel and watch-credits actions are retained.

patches.name: Experimental: persistent VOD playback speed
patches.description: Experimental saved playback speed for direct VOD. Opt-in; live and Google DAI remain at normal speed.

patches.name: Experimental: reduce telemetry
patches.description: Adds an off-by-default setting to suppress selected navigation, interaction and playback analytics events. SDK initialization remains enabled.

patches.name: Experimental: remember video quality
patches.description: Adds optional remembered bitrate, automatic, and highest-supported quality modes to Morphe settings. Disabled at runtime by default; SBS mobile 6.4.0 only.

patches.name: Experimental: uninterrupted watching
patches.description: Adds an opt-in switch to stop inactivity prompts and their player exit. Long-pause stream refresh is preserved.

patches.name: Morphe settings
patches.description: Adds Morphe settings above App Settings and Language in the account menu.

patches.name: Prefer direct VOD stream
patches.description: Removes pre-roll and mid-roll video ads by selecting SBS's direct VOD stream when available.

patches.name: Prefer direct live stream
patches.description: Removes extra video ads from live TV by selecting the direct stream when available. Ads in the broadcast remain.

patches.name: SBS playback compatibility check
patches.description: Verifies the playback methods required by the VOD and live ad-removal patches.
